title: Wrong primitive input type is accepted by the server but should fail client preflight

source.observation: ZOO accepted this description-invalid value with HTTP 201 and created a running job.

must: Identify inputs.sid and report that the description requires an integer or null, not a string.
Preserve the user's original value; do not silently coerce it.
If an explicit raw submission bypasses generated-form validation, still interpret HTTP 201 as job accepted and make the job dismissible.
must_not: Send this body from the ordinary description-driven form flow.
Conclude that the process description permits strings because this server accepted one.
Report process success from the observed HTTP 201.

must: Use explicit DELETE to clean up the server job if the manual submission step was executed.
must_not: Assume cancelling the local POST removed the accepted job.
